rejected_rule.statement: Only the quit notice must be in the statutorily prescribed Form 'A', whereas the application to the Court (Form 'B') and the supporting affidavit (Form 'C') do not need to adhere to the same level of formality.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: However, based on the analysis of the relevant provisions of the Act, it is my considered view that only the quit notice must be in the statutorily prescribed Form 'A', whereas the application to the Court (Form 'B') and the supporting affidavit (Form 'C') do not need to adhere to the same level of formality.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: State Land (Recovery of Possession) Act No. 07 of 1999, as amended
